title: The Returning Signal
subtitle: what keeps finding you
mapEpigraph: What returns has survived your forgetting.

blocks.instruction: Make the unedited list: ideas, people, places, problems, images, and futures you cannot stop thinking about.

prompts.text: Which three feel alive rather than merely important?
The three things that feel most alive are…

blocks.title: Things I can't stop thinking about
blocks.instruction: Write the list. Circle three by aliveness, not logic.

blocks.closing: Notice whether one of the three finds you again before day's end.
